lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 20 -- Your First Week in Miami

listenings.text: Welcome to the Brickell Bay Hotel. Breakfast is on the second floor, from six to ten. The gym is open from five in the morning to eleven at night. The elevators are on the left, near the café. To call the reception, press zero in your room. Check-out is at twelve. Have a nice stay!

Hi, it's Paul. A small piece of advice for your first week. At the hotel, the room key is a card, not a key. Keep it in your wallet, not with your phone. In the office, people say good morning in the elevator. It's normal, and it's nice. And on a call with São Paulo, remember the time zone. Miami is one hour behind São Paulo now. So a call at ten in Miami is at eleven in São Paulo.

extra_audio.text: I arrive at the hotel in Miami. I have a reservation. Here is my key. My room is on the twelfth floor. I take the elevator.
